title: Who will win the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in Kansas in 2026?
background: Kansas will hold a U.S. Senate election in November 2026, with party nominees selected in the August primary.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Results reported by Kansas election authorities or definitive election reporting from a major news organization. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the winner of Kansas's Democratic U.S. Senate primary scheduled for August 4, 2026, once the outcome is unambiguously reported. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate's full name.
